adjudication.rationale: In `lib/topic_retriever.rb` `perform_retrieve` does call `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` synchronously whenever `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true, on every uncached embed retrieval (`perform_retrieve` runs inside `TopicRetriever#retrieve`). That is a real perf/architecture concern (re-polling a whole feed per embed miss). However, the claim that it “falls through to `fetch_http` without checking `feed_polling_url`” is misleading as a defect: `Jobs::PollFeed#execute` itself guards on `feed_polling_url.present?` and `embed_by_username.present?` (see `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`), so missing an explicit check in `TopicRetriever` doesn’t change correctness. The broader point that there is no setting to make it feed-only (it will still `fetch_http` and scrape if feed doesn’t create the embed) is a valid product/scope concern grounded in `perform_retrieve`’s fallback behavior, but not an outright bug per the diff.
